name: karrkarr-fleet
description: Karrkarr Pte Ltd Fleet Leasing Management Platform

scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && sleep 5 && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.postinstall: (cd packages/shared && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --outDir dist --declaration false --skipLibCheck true --esModuleInterop true 2>&1; true) && (cd apps/api && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma generate 2>&1 && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma db push --accept-data-loss 2>&1 && ./node_modules/.bin/nest build 2>&1)
